svg.title: Two consumer groups reading four partitions
svg.desc: Topic orders has partitions p0 to p3. Group billing has consumers c1 and c2: c1 owns p0 and p2, c2 owns p1 and p3. Group email has its own c1 and c2 with the same round-robin split. Each group reads every message once; within a group each partition has exactly one owner.
svg.text: email reads the same messages with its own cursors
